rule: R-REBUILD-01 clause two / a deferral is a decision with a measurement, never a rule
note: EMPTY AT ADOPTION, deliberately. All six passages found on the gate's first run already carried their own measurement (+55% on AMOC's re-anchor, 105 basis points on FERTIGLOBE's net weights), so correcting them was rewriting the REASON and keeping the number -- no value moved and nothing had to be excused. A list created for nothing is a list nobody maintains. May only ever SHORTEN.
